designObjective: Prove that DangoUI has been learned as a quiet, responsive technical documentation system with role-separated navigation and component purples, compact controls, and clear long-form hierarchy—not as a generic purple business skin.
visualPriorityOrder: strict separation of navigation and Primary Button purple roles

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A quiet technical documentation page whose full-width utility header, strong black title, restrained supporting surface and explicit system hierarchy are recognizable before any purple branding is noticed.
mustNotDo: turn every block into a floating card
replace the technical-flow surface with generic summary cards
apply purple as a page wash
reproduce the source mobile title occlusion

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A component reference page where a compact live Primary Button and code/example relationship prove precise system behavior instead of a generic showcase CTA.
mustPreserve: at least two independently QA-addressable page sections
mustNotDo: collapse the reference page to one live example and a short checklist
put an attempt or run label in the composition variant
use a materially different source/demo aspect without a frozen mayTranslate authorization

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A new release-readiness article should still feel native to the learned DangoUI documentation system despite having no one-to-one source page.
mustNotDo: flatten into a generic card dashboard

responsiveStrategyMatrix.minimumReadableSize: 11px desktop navigation / hidden secondary zones on phone
11px desktop / equivalent location cue on phone

proofSurfacePlan.desktopCanvas: Independent 1440x900 source/demo calibration without inspector width counted as page width.
proofSurfacePlan.mobileCanvas: Independent 390x844 source/demo calibration; normal product route retains phone mockup while proof mode exposes the exact content viewport.
proofSurfacePlan.inspectorPolicy: Exclude rail, selected-node outline, mockup bezel and home indicator from source-fidelity crops.
proofSurfacePlan.sourceComparison: Same-viewport Introduction and Button comparisons plus a separate held-out release-checklist screenshot. The source mobile title overlap is documented as a defect and must not be copied.

insetReadingColumn.demoRequirement: bounded inset article only; preserve heading-first reading order

mobileLayerRegions.forbidden: Do not use [0,0,1,1] for either mobile layer.

buttonCompositionComparison.variantNaming: Source and calibration Demo use the same stable DOM/CSS variant; attempt labels belong outside variant.
buttonCompositionComparison.reason: The frozen goal has no mayTranslate entry authorizing aspect/crop translation or asset variant replacement.
buttonCompositionComparison.demoRequirement: Use same-aspect, bounded, like-for-like comparison regions and retain purpose/import → preview/code → API → theme reading order. If this cannot be represented truthfully, Demo must change its proof regions; the contract must not fabricate authorization.

orchestratorDecision.reason: The overlap contradicts the top visual priority and is not an approved brand invariant.
orchestratorDecision.demoRegistration: Only after implementation self-test and Blind QA; no Evidence-stage registry mutation.
